status: pre-registered before historical breadth backfill and formal result execution
hypothesis: Point-in-time participation breadth across individual Taiwan stocks is a market internal-state variable that adds 20-trading-day TWII direction beyond index trend and aggregate FinMind factors.

target.decision_time: after all date-t cash and institutional source data are available
target.effective_sample: origins separated by at least 20 TWII trading rows

data.point_in_time_universe: security rows actually returned on each source date whose stock_id matches ^[1-9][0-9]{3}$
data.survivorship_rule: never filter a historical day with the current TaiwanStockInfo list
data.feasibility_amendment: Before any formal backfill result or target validation, probes found 96 institutional rows on 2005-01-06, only 19 on 2008-02-29, and zero rows from both FinMind sources on 2014-07-23 while canonical TWII duplicated the prior day's full OHLCV. The originally shared 100-stock threshold was split into price 100 and institutional 50; dates below 50 institutional active stocks are terminal feature exclusions but remain in the actual cash trading clock when price rows exist. Dates with both sources empty are terminal no-market exclusions and are removed from the trading clock. The 20-day target is anchored to this FinMind-price-present cash trading sequence. No model outcome was inspected.
data.retrieval_semantics: FinMind all-market mode returns exactly start_date; fetch one TWII trading date per source request, with the two sources allowed to run concurrently

price_breadth_additions: positive and negative two-percent tail fractions
top-ten trading-money concentration and median log trading money
institutional_breadth_additions: foreign, investment-trust and era-consistent combined-dealer positive/negative fractions
investor-level median and aggregate net/gross intensity
combined institutional breadth and median/aggregate intensity

variants.index_aggregate_control: locked causal index trend/volatility plus aggregate FinMind cash-institution features
variants.plus_price_and_institutional_breadth: control plus all registered breadth additions

simple_baselines: sign of same-day combined institutional breadth

walk_forward.configuration_selection: accuracy first, then coverage, using only the prior validation segment
walk_forward.formal_effective_records: greedy chronological origins separated by at least 20 TWII trading rows
